posts.title: Unemployment By Province
posts.caption:
Which province has the highest unemployment? In Q2 2026, the Eastern Cape recorded 47.5%, compared with 19.5% in the Western Cape. South Africa’s unemployment rate was 33.6%.

#SouthAfrica #Unemployment #StatsSA

posts.title: Youth Unemployment
posts.caption:
Finding work remains a major challenge for young South Africans. In Q1 2025, North West had the highest youth unemployment rate at 58.8%, while Western Cape was lowest at 27.2%. These are rates among young people aged 15–34 in the labour force.

#YouthUnemployment #SouthAfrica #Jobs

posts.title: Biggest Provincial Economy
posts.caption:
Gauteng is South Africa’s economic powerhouse. In 2024, it contributed 33.2% of national GDP, followed by KwaZulu-Natal (16.1%) and Western Cape (14.2%).

#SouthAfrica #Economy #GDP

posts.title: Fastest-Growing Economy
posts.caption:
Which province grew fastest in 2024? Limpopo led with 0.9% real GDP growth, followed by Gauteng at 0.8% and Western Cape at 0.7%. National real GDP growth was 0.5%.

#SouthAfrica #EconomicGrowth #StatsSA

posts.title: Population By Province
posts.caption:
Where do most South Africans live? Gauteng leads with approximately 16.29 million people, followed by KwaZulu-Natal at 12.29 million. South Africa’s estimated population in 2026 is about 63.52 million.

#SouthAfrica #Population #Demographics

posts.title: Where South Africans Move
posts.caption:
Gauteng attracted the biggest share of South Africans counted as moving between provinces in Census 2022: 34.4%, followed by Western Cape at 19.8%. These are shares of interprovincial in-migrants, not population migration rates.

#SouthAfrica #Migration #Census2022

posts.title: Youngest Populations
posts.caption:
Which province has the youngest population? In 2026, 31.0% of Limpopo residents are estimated to be under 15 years old, followed by Eastern Cape at 29.6%. Gauteng and Western Cape each have 21.5%.

#SouthAfrica #YoungPopulation #Demographics

posts.title: Matric Pass Rates
posts.caption:
KwaZulu-Natal topped the 2025 National Senior Certificate pass rates at 90.60%. Free State followed at 89.33%, with Gauteng at 89.06%. The national pass rate was 88.0%.

#SouthAfrica #Matric2025 #Education

posts.title: Tap-Water Access
posts.caption:
Tap-water access differs widely across South Africa. In 2024, Western Cape reported 99.0% of households with access to piped or tap water, compared with 62.9% in Limpopo. This measures access, not verified drinking-water safety.

#SouthAfrica #WaterAccess #StatsSA

posts.title: Water Interruptions
posts.caption:
Water interruptions remain a serious problem. In 2024, 66.2% of households in Mpumalanga reported a water interruption lasting at least two days, compared with 5.6% in Western Cape.

#SouthAfrica #WaterCrisis #StatsSA

posts.title: Improved Sanitation
posts.caption:
In 2024, 83.1% of South African households had access to improved sanitation. Western Cape led at 97.1%, while Limpopo was at 62.2%. Improved sanitation includes flush toilets and ventilated improved pit toilets.

#SouthAfrica #Sanitation #StatsSA

posts.title: Mains Electricity Access
posts.caption:
Which province has the most households connected to mains electricity? In 2024 Limpopo led at 96.6%, followed by Western Cape at 96.0%. Gauteng reported 83.2%. These figures measure a mains connection, not uninterrupted power.

#SouthAfrica #Electricity #Infrastructure

posts.title: Internet Access
posts.caption:
In 2024, 92.0% of Western Cape households had at least one member accessing the internet from somewhere, compared with 70.3% in Northern Cape. Nationally, the figure was 82.1%.

#SouthAfrica #InternetAccess #DigitalDivide

posts.title: Informal Housing
posts.caption:
What proportion of households live in informal dwellings? In 2024, Western Cape reported 18.6%, compared with 2.5% in Limpopo. Nationally, the figure was 11.7%.

#SouthAfrica #Housing #StatsSA

posts.title: Housebreaking By Province
posts.caption:
The 2023/24 victim-of-crime survey found that 10.3% of Northern Cape households experienced housebreaking, versus 3.6% in Free State. These are household-survey rates, not police case counts.

#SouthAfrica #CrimeStats #Safety

posts.title: Safe Walking After Dark
posts.caption:
How safe do South Africans feel after dark? In the 2023/24 survey, 61.1% of Limpopo residents said they felt safe walking alone at night, compared with 25.3% in Mpumalanga. These results measure feelings of safety, not crime rates.

#SouthAfrica #PublicSafety #StatsSA

posts.title: Easter Road Fatalities
posts.caption:
During the Easter 2025 holiday road-safety reporting period, Mpumalanga accounted for about 16.1% of reported road fatalities, followed by KwaZulu-Natal at 15.6%. These percentages describe Easter road deaths, not annual fatality risk or fatalities per driver.

#SouthAfrica #RoadSafety #Easter2025

posts.title: Medical Aid Coverage
posts.caption:
Medical aid coverage remains unequal across South Africa. In 2024, 25.4% of Western Cape residents reported medical aid coverage, compared with 10.0% in Limpopo. Nationally, it was 15.5%.

#SouthAfrica #Healthcare #MedicalAid

posts.title: Inadequate Food Access
posts.caption:
Food access remains a challenge in many communities. In 2024, Northern Cape had about 34.3% of households with inadequate or severely inadequate access to food, while Limpopo recorded about 5.9%. Components may differ slightly due to rounding.

#SouthAfrica #FoodSecurity #StatsSA

posts.title: What Changed Since 2002?
posts.caption:
Has access to basic services improved since 2002? Nationally, improved sanitation rose from 61.7% of households in 2002 to 83.1% in 2024 — up 21.4 percentage points. Eastern Cape improved by 56.5 percentage points and Limpopo by 35.3 points.

#SouthAfrica #Progress #Sanitation

posts.title: Which Province Is The Largest?
posts.caption:
South Africa’s provinces vary hugely in size! 🗺️ The Northern Cape is the biggest at 372,889 km², while Gauteng is the smallest at just 18,178 km². Which province are you from?

#SouthAfrica #Provinces #Geography #Mzansi

posts.title: Where Are Households The Biggest?
posts.caption:
How many people live in the average household? 🏡 Census 2022 shows KwaZulu-Natal had the largest average household size at 4.4 people, while Gauteng had the smallest at 2.8. The national average was 3.5.

#SouthAfrica #Census2022 #Households #StatsSA

posts.title: Where Do Women Head Most Homes?
posts.caption:
Women head almost half of South Africa’s households. 👩🏽‍💼 According to Census 2022, KwaZulu-Natal had the highest share of female-headed households (53.1%), followed by the Eastern Cape (51.9%) and Limpopo (51.6%).

#SouthAfrica #Women #Census2022 #StatsSA

posts.title: Which Province Has Most Households?
posts.caption:
Gauteng has more households than any other province! 🏠 Census 2022 counted about 5.32 million Gauteng households, compared with 2.85 million in KwaZulu-Natal and 333,553 in the Northern Cape. National total: 17.83 million.

#SouthAfrica #Households #Census2022 #ProvincialStats

posts.title: Where Did Population Grow Fastest?
posts.caption:
Which province grew the fastest? 📈 Between the 2011 and 2022 censuses, the Western Cape population grew by 27.7%, narrowly ahead of Mpumalanga (27.3%). These are total changes over 11 years, not annual growth rates.

#SouthAfrica #Population #Census2022 #StatsSA

posts.title: Which Province Has More Men?
posts.caption:
Only Gauteng has more men than women (101.8 males per 100 females). 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.7).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are Children Missing Ecd?
posts.caption:
Northern Cape recorded 56.7% of children aged 0–4 not attending an ECD programme. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 4.1).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Do Most Young Children Attend Creche?
posts.caption:
Western Cape and Free State both recorded 44.1% of children aged 0–4 attending a crèche or educare centre. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 4.1).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Has The Most Adults Without Schooling?
posts.caption:
Limpopo had the highest proportion of adults aged 20+ with no schooling, using Census 2022 totals. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 4.6 (calculated)).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Have Most Adults Finished Secondary School?
posts.caption:
Gauteng had the highest proportion of people aged 20+ whose highest attainment was completed secondary schooling. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 4.6 (calculated)).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Leads In Post-School Education?
posts.caption:
Western Cape leads the share of residents aged 20+ with post-school education, followed by Gauteng. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 4.6 (calculated)).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are More Children Non-Orphans?
posts.caption:
Western Cape had the highest percentage of children classified as non-orphans in Census 2022. The classification concerns parental survival. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 6.2).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are Paternal Orphan Rates Highest?
posts.caption:
Eastern Cape recorded the highest proportion of paternal orphans among children aged 0–17 in Census 2022. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 6.2).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Were Most Homeless People Counted?
posts.caption:
Gauteng accounted for 25,384 of the 55,719 people recorded as homeless in Census 2022. Counts do not measure per-capita risk. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 7.2).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Counted The Most Roofless People?
posts.caption:
Gauteng recorded 23,455 roofless people in Census 2022, more than any other province. These are counts, not population-adjusted rates. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 7.2).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are The Most Agricultural Households?
posts.caption:
KwaZulu-Natal recorded about 549,000 agricultural households in Census 2022, just ahead of Limpopo. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.1).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Household Farming Most Common?
posts.caption:
Limpopo had the largest proportion of households involved in agriculture in Census 2022. This includes household-level farming, not just commercial farms. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.1 (calculated)).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are Most Backyard Farming Households?
posts.caption:
KwaZulu-Natal recorded the most agricultural households using a backyard, followed closely by Limpopo. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.5).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Do Farmers Grow Food Only For Home Use?
posts.caption:
In several provinces more than four out of five agricultural households produced only for their own consumption in Census 2022. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.7 (calculated)).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Do Most Households Keep Livestock Or Poultry?
posts.caption:
Eastern Cape and KwaZulu-Natal each recorded roughly 247,000 households producing livestock or poultry. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.3).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Has The Most Cattle?
posts.caption:
Eastern Cape led the household cattle count in Census 2022, with more than 3.9 million cattle reported. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Has The Most Sheep?
posts.caption:
The Eastern Cape reported more than 10 million sheep in Census 2022—far ahead of other provinces. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Has The Most Goats?
posts.caption:
Eastern Cape recorded over 2.4 million goats in Census 2022, followed by KwaZulu-Natal. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Has The Most Pigs?
posts.caption:
Eastern Cape reported the highest household pig count in Census 2022, at over 484,000. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Which Province Has The Most Chickens?
posts.caption:
KwaZulu-Natal led household chicken counts in Census 2022, with approximately 7.77 million birds. 🗺️ See how all nine provinces compare on the map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 9.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are Rented Homes Most Common?
posts.caption:
Gauteng had the highest proportion of households living in rented homes (36.6%), compared with 10.0% in Limpopo. These are shares of households, not rental prices. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Figure 8.6).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Do Most Households Live Rent-Free?
posts.caption:
Limpopo had the highest proportion of households living in rent-free dwellings (37.9%). The Western Cape had the lowest share at 18.2%. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Figure 8.6).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are Homes Most Often Fully Paid Off?
posts.caption:
In Mpumalanga, 52.9% of households lived in dwellings that were owned and fully paid off, followed by the Free State at 51.2%. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Figure 8.6).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are Owned Homes Still Being Paid Off?
posts.caption:
The Western Cape led the share of households living in owned dwellings that were not fully paid off (12.6%). In Limpopo, the figure was 2.9%. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Figure 8.6).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Isizulu Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
IsiZulu was the language most often spoken at home by 80.0% of residents aged 1+ in KwaZulu-Natal, compared with 27.8% in Mpumalanga. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Isixhosa Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
IsiXhosa was most often spoken at home by 81.8% of residents aged 1+ in the Eastern Cape, followed by 31.4% in the Western Cape. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Afrikaans Most Common At Home?
posts.caption:
Afrikaans was the language most often spoken at home by 54.6% of residents aged 1+ in the Northern Cape and 41.2% in the Western Cape. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is English Most Common At Home?
posts.caption:
English was the language most often spoken at home by 22.0% of residents aged 1+ in the Western Cape, followed by 14.4% in KwaZulu-Natal. This does not measure how many people can speak English. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Sesotho Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
Sesotho was the language most often spoken at home by 72.3% of residents aged 1+ in the Free State. Gauteng followed at 13.1%. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Setswana Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
Setswana was the language most often spoken at home by 72.8% of residents aged 1+ in North West, followed by 35.7% in the Northern Cape. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Isindebele Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
Census 2022 recorded isiNdebele as the main home language for 9.9% of residents aged 1+ in Mpumalanga, compared with 3.1% in Gauteng. This measures the language spoken most often at home, not fluency. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Sepedi Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
In Limpopo, 55.5% of residents aged 1+ most often spoke Sepedi at home. Gauteng followed with 12.6%. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Siswati Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
Mpumalanga had the highest share of residents aged 1+ speaking siSwati most often at home (30.5%) in Census 2022. Gauteng followed with 0.9%. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Tshivenda Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
Tshivenda was spoken most often at home by 17.4% of Limpopo residents aged 1+, compared with 2.4% in Gauteng. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Xitsonga Spoken Most At Home?
posts.caption:
Limpopo led for Xitsonga as the main home language (17.3% of residents aged 1+), followed by Mpumalanga at 10.6%. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Table 2.9).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Is Weekly Rubbish Collection Most Common?
posts.caption:
The Western Cape recorded the highest share of households with weekly refuse removal in Census 2022 (90.4%), while Limpopo recorded 32.2%. This measures collection frequency, not overall cleanliness. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Municipal Fact Sheet • Household services).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Did Weekly Waste Collection Improve Most?
posts.caption:
Eastern Cape recorded the largest rise in household weekly refuse-removal coverage between 2011 and 2022: +12.9 percentage points. Free State declined by 5.9 points. These are percentage-point changes, not growth rates. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Municipal Fact Sheet • Household services).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Do Most Households Have Piped Water On-Site?
posts.caption:
Gauteng led for piped water inside a dwelling or yard in Census 2022, at 94.1% of households. Limpopo had the lowest share at 61.1%. This does not measure water quality or reliability. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Municipal Fact Sheet • Household services).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Has On-Site Piped Water Access Grown Most?
posts.caption:
Between the 2011 and 2022 censuses, the Eastern Cape saw the biggest improvement in piped-water access inside homes or yards: +17.7 percentage points, followed by KwaZulu-Natal at +13.4 points. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Municipal Fact Sheet • Household services).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022

posts.title: Where Are Sewer-Connected Flush Toilets Most Common?
posts.caption:
In 2022, 93.9% of Western Cape households had a flush toilet connected to sewerage, compared with 35.2% in Limpopo. This specifically measures sewer-connected flush toilets, not every type of improved toilet. 🗺️ Compare all nine provinces on our map.

Source: Statistics South Africa, Census 2022 (Municipal Fact Sheet • Household services).

#SouthAfrica #SAByProvince #StatsSA #Census2022
